rationale.max_smoothing_sigma_m: 100 to 1000 m Gaussian derivative scales, corresponding to 1 to 10 pixels on the competition grid; test whether geodetic strain boundaries persist beyond pixel noise
rationale.min_orientation_coherence: axial orientation agreement across three strain-gradient scales; sampled rather than selected by candidate name
rationale.prediction_fraction: candidate emitted mass, selected only from development quadrants and scored at the same per-candidate mass against each comparison arm
rationale.strain_source: balanced categorical choice among the provided strain invariant, shear rate, dilatation rate, and their equal-evidence union
rationale.holdout_caveat: NW was already inspected for H35-01. This challenger comparison is not an untouched validation; a positive result is a local promotion screen only and requires fresh-block confirmation before strong claims.
